Genome-bin identifier of a position

Source: R/hc3_stats.R
make_bin.Rd

Genome-bin identifier of a position

Usage

make_bin(chr, pos, bin_width = 20000)

Arguments

chr

Chromosome name(s).

pos

1-based position(s).

bin_width

Bin width in bp.

Value

Character vector "<chr>-<start>-<end>" of the fixed-width bin holding each position, always in plain (never scientific) notation.

Examples

make_bin("chr1", c(1, 20000, 20001, 99999))
#> [1] "chr1-1-20000"      "chr1-1-20000"      "chr1-20001-40000" 
#> [4] "chr1-80001-100000"
